paragraphs.en: On 23 September 1976 fourteen people signed the «Apel do społeczeństwa i władz PRL», the founding text of the Komitet Obrony Robotników. Among them were Jacek Kuroń, Jan Józef Lipski, Stanisław Barańczak, Jerzy Andrzejewski and the priest Jan Zieja. KOR organised legal and material help for the workers and their families.

paragraphs.en: President Ignacy Mościcki founded Polskie Koleje Państwowe by decree on 24 September 1926. The Sejm made 2026 the Year of Polish Railways. The block shows four trains from those hundred years, each on a long stamp of 76.5 × 31.25 mm.

paragraphs.en: The Luxtorpeda was a fast diesel railcar. Fablok in Chrzanów built five of them in 1936, after an Austrian prototype. On a special run without passengers one covered the line from Kraków to Zakopane in 2 hours 18 minutes.

paragraphs.en: The ICN, «Intercity Nieśpieszny», is PKP Intercity's retro train of 2026. It runs olive coaches in the style of the 1980s behind older electric locomotives of the EP and EU series. PKP Intercity introduced it in spring 2026 for its 25th anniversary.

paragraphs.en: The Luxtorpeda ran on the line from Kraków to Zakopane. In regular service the trip took 2 hours 45 minutes on average. The photo from the Narodowe Archiwum Cyfrowe shows one of the railcars at Zakopane station in 1936, with Giewont behind it.

paragraphs.en: On 26 September 2025 the Sejm declared 2026 the Year of Health Prevention. The resolution asks for more screening and earlier diagnosis, also in small towns and in places with poor transport.

paragraphs.en: Roch Stefaniak designed the stamp around the logo of «10 dla zdrowia», a health check from the Ministry of Health in the mojeIKP app. The ten icons along the top edge stand for its areas: blood pressure, LDL cholesterol, blood sugar, body weight, diet, exercise, sleep, stress, tobacco and alcohol. Below the logo a runner follows a path over green hills next to a family sitting on the grass.

paragraphs.en: Krzysztof Skubiszewski was born in Poznań on 8 October 1926. He was a professor of international law. From September 1989 to October 1993 he was foreign minister in four governments, from Tadeusz Mazowiecki to Hanna Suchocka.

paragraphs.en: On 17 July 1990 he took part in the 2+4 talks on German unity in Paris, at the session on Poland's western border. On 14 November 1990 he signed the border treaty with Germany together with Hans-Dietrich Genscher. From 1994 until his death in 2010 he was president of the Iran-United States Claims Tribunal in The Hague.

paragraphs.en: 9 October is World Post Day. On that day in 1874 delegates signed the Treaty of Bern, which founded the General Postal Union, today's Universal Postal Union. Polish philately begins with «Polska nr 1», the 10-kopeck stamp of the Kingdom of Poland that came into use on 1 January 1860.

Polska filatelistyka zaczyna się od „Polski nr 1”, znaczka za 10 kopiejek Królestwa Polskiego, wprowadzonego do obiegu 1 stycznia 1860 roku.

paragraphs.en: The stamp shows a mail coach drawn by horses, taken from the engraving «Kurierka pocztowa na trakcie bitym». The margin shows objects from the Muzeum Poczty i Telekomunikacji in Wrocław: a post horn, a postman's bag, the gold badge of a city postman and a silver stamp case made for the 400th anniversary of the discovery of America.
